Subject: Quick intro + demo request

Hi Naomi,

I signed up on the site and wanted to follow up directly — Novus AI is evaluating a hosted inference provider for our customer-support answer-ranking feature. High level: we take incoming support requests and run a reranker over candidate answers to pick the best final suggestion.

Rough traffic: ~800k asks/day now, expect to get to ~2M asks/day in 6 months. Peak concurrency unknown but some days see big spikes when product releases go out.

Pilot timeline: we want a small pilot in September, with go-live for an initial tranche in Q4 if everything looks good.

Two quick asks before scheduling:
- Are there SSO/SCIM requirements for pilot access?
- Do you offer a sandbox with realistic token pricing for evals?

Happy to share a short sample CSV of traffic patterns — attaching a tiny extract. Would love a 30-min demo to cover fit and timeline.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer

alex@novusai.com
+1 (415) 555-0197

Thanks Naomi — answered inline below and attached a short SSO requirements PDF your security team can scan.

> 1) Typical sequence length / average tokens per request?
On average ~120 tokens per request; some multi-turn followups push that to ~350 occasionally.

> 2) Is the reranker running purely text->text, or are you doing embeddings + similarity steps before ranking?
We do a hybrid: light embedding-based candidate retrieval followed by a neural reranker. The reranker is text->text model scoring candidates.

> 3) Expected queries per second at peak vs 95th perc for the pilot slice?
Pilot will exercise about 30 TPS sustained with burst to 120 TPS for short windows (a few minutes). For production we expect 300–500 TPS sustained eventually.

> 4) Do you need HIPAA / PCI considerations, or is this standard PII-safe support data?
No HIPAA/PCI. Data is customer support transcripts — PII is redaction-ready; we can provide a sanitized sample.

We’re happy to do Tue Aug 11 at 2pm PT. If that slot is still ok for you and Ben, please send an invite.

— Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of ML, Novus AI

Attachment: sso-requirements.pdf (PDF, 132KB)
